title: Reading Text Messages 1
description: Short, informal text messages with abbreviations and emoji. What do they mean?

thumbnail.alt: A smartphone screen with chat bubbles

questions.prompt: Message: "Running 10 min late, start without me!" — What should the friends do?
questions.explanation: "Start without me" = don't wait for me.

questions.prompt: Message: "Can u grab some milk on ur way home? We're out." — What does the writer want?
questions.explanation: "Grab" = get/buy quickly. "We're out" = we don't have any.

questions.prompt: Message: "Movie's at 7:30. Meet at the entrance 15 mins before?" — When and where should they meet?
Message: "Sorry, can't make it tonight 😞 Rain check?" — What does the writer mean?

options.text: She can't come and wants to do it another time.
She wants to check the weather.

questions.explanation: "Rain check" = let's do it another day.

questions.prompt: Message: "BRB, my mom's calling" — What does BRB mean?
Message: "Your package will be delivered tomorrow between 9am–1pm. Reply STOP to unsubscribe." — When will the package arrive?
Message: "Happy bday!! 🎉 Lunch is on me this weekend" — What does "lunch is on me" mean?

options.text: The writer will pay for lunch.
Lunch is at the writer's house.

questions.prompt: Message: "Don't forget: the test is moved to Monday, not Friday!" — What changed?

options.text: The test is now on Monday.
The test is now on Friday.

questions.explanation: "Moved to Monday" = the new day is Monday.
